$description: The look of the product: every color, distance, type size, radius and motion, in the W3C Design Tokens format. This file is the source. Language projections are generated from it.

color.$description: Graphite surfaces, muted iris actions and gold rewards. Each game owns its playing surface.

surfaceMuted.$description: Sunken well (`surface-sunken`): inputs, media wells, empty board cells, tags, inactive stat pills.

surfaceElevated.$description: Raised above the canvas: dialogs and sheets (`surface-raised`).

surfaceOverlay.$description: Floating above content: popovers, menus, tooltips (`surface-raised`).

icon.$description: Glyphs at rest; the `ink-muted` value, held to 3:1.

tint.$description: Primary as text (`primary-ink`): links and selected labels. Never a fill.

tintActive.$description: The primary play or commit action, paired with onPrimary.

tintSubtle.$description: Selected chip, active turn, active player, your avatar (`primary-soft`).

primaryStrong.$description: Selected borders, active indicators, your own pieces (`primary-strong`).

outline.$description: Borders that carry meaning (`line-strong`): inputs, secondary buttons, unselected chips. Held to 3:1.

focusRing.$description: The 2px focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive control (`focus`).

destructive.$description: Resign, errors, destructive actions as text (`danger`); always with a word or icon.

destructiveActive.$description: Solid danger fill paired with onDestructive.

success.$description: Success (`success`); always with a word or icon.

live.$description: Only the LIVE pill and the recording dot, under white text.

pathRed.$description: Labeled game paths and endpoint outlines, never application chrome.

pathOrange.$description: Labeled game paths and endpoint outlines, never application chrome.

pathYellow.$description: Labeled game paths and endpoint outlines, never application chrome.

pathGreen.$description: Labeled game paths and endpoint outlines, never application chrome.

pathBlue.$description: Labeled game paths and endpoint outlines, never application chrome.

pathPurple.$description: Labeled game paths and endpoint outlines, never application chrome.

player1.$description: Seat 1 color in multiplayer games. The eight seat colors differ in lightness, not only hue; the viewer's own pieces use `primaryStrong` where the game allows.

player2.$description: Seat 2 color in multiplayer games. The eight seat colors differ in lightness, not only hue; the viewer's own pieces use `primaryStrong` where the game allows.

player3.$description: Seat 3 color in multiplayer games. The eight seat colors differ in lightness, not only hue; the viewer's own pieces use `primaryStrong` where the game allows.

player4.$description: Seat 4 color in multiplayer games. The eight seat colors differ in lightness, not only hue; the viewer's own pieces use `primaryStrong` where the game allows.

player5.$description: Seat 5 color in multiplayer games. The eight seat colors differ in lightness, not only hue; the viewer's own pieces use `primaryStrong` where the game allows.

player6.$description: Seat 6 color in multiplayer games. The eight seat colors differ in lightness, not only hue; the viewer's own pieces use `primaryStrong` where the game allows.

player7.$description: Seat 7 color in multiplayer games. The eight seat colors differ in lightness, not only hue; the viewer's own pieces use `primaryStrong` where the game allows.

player8.$description: Seat 8 color in multiplayer games. The eight seat colors differ in lightness, not only hue; the viewer's own pieces use `primaryStrong` where the game allows.

monogram1.$description: A space keeps its identifying color. Use onMonogram for the letter.

boardLight.$description: Light square of the shared chessboard.

boardDark.$description: Dark squares of a checkered board.

boardHighlight.$description: Last-move and selected-square wash over a board square.

boardCell.$description: An empty board cell or slot.

boardCardInk.$description: Black suits and card text on `boardCardFace`.

gameConnectFourCanvas.$description: ConnectFour board only: canvas (its empty places).

gameQuoridorThree.$description: Quoridor board only: third pawn ink (gold), readable on the sand board.

gameSokobanFocus.$description: Sokoban board only: focus ring on the page, at least 3:1 against the page and the board edge.

rewardSurface.$description: Quiet backdrop for an earned result.

onMonogram.$description: Letter on a colored space tile.

actionShade.$description: Subtle lower edge of a filled control.

materialGlint.$description: Neutral upper-left light on edges and the curved faces of playing pieces.

tone.$description: Semantic text and surface roles name a color in the application palette.

scale.$description: The 4px grid. Step n is n x 4px.

role.$description: Named distances for page insets and stacks, so density is one edit. Phone gutters (`page`) are 16.

size.$description: The t-shirt scale every `gap` and `padding` prop takes. Every step is on the 4px grid.

family.$description: One face. `sans` (Manrope) sets every line of copy, including display headlines; `display` is the same face for numbers (ratings, scores, clocks and counts), set with tabular figures. Self-hosted with `font-display: swap`. `mono` is for code and identifiers only.

size.$description: The type scale. `xs` label 12, `sm` caption 14, `base` body 15, `lg` title 18, `xl` stat 20, `2xl` display 26, `3xl` display-xl 40. Nothing renders below 12px.

weight.$description: Manrope 400 body, 500 captions, 600 numbers, 700 emphasis, titles and display headlines.

typography.$description: The eight text styles. A component names a style, never a size, weight or face. `stat` is for numbers only.

role.$description: Radius encodes hierarchy: `sm` (6) small details, `control` (12) inputs, actions and choices, `card` (12) cards and lists, `sheet` (20) sheets and boards, `full` avatars, counters, floating controls and stat pills.

duration.$description: Short and calm: 150 to 250ms. `instant` is no motion.

easing.$description: Ease-out for everything that answers a person.

control.$description: Minimum height of a control: `sm` compact buttons, `md` the default button and field, `lg` a prominent action and list rows.

maxWidth.$description: Reading and layout measures. `full` (100%) is a keyword, not a token.

space.$description: The desktop column inside an open space: its top bar and every screen in it share these edges (960px inside the column's 16px insets).

panel.$description: The panel beside a desktop board (a game's record and commands, a puzzle's prompt and moves): one width for every game and puzzle, so a board and its panel fill the space column together.

breakpoint.$description: Minimum viewport widths. The only widths a responsive prop may branch on.

layer.$description: Stacking order of app-level hosts, lowest first.

shadow.$description: Upper-left light defines raised faces, inset sockets and small contact shadows. Each layer is static.
